title: The Secret Price Behind Your Eggs
sentence: On June 29, 2026, the U.S. Justice Department and 17 states alleged that Cal-Maine, Versova and Hickman's coordinated bids on the Egg Clearinghouse to push up Urner Barry's benchmark egg quotes from 2022 to 2025; the companies denied wrongdoing and settled for $3.3 million and 53 million eggs.
source: Quartz via Yahoo Finance, DOJ and states settle egg price case (June 30, 2026): https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/commodities/articles/doj-states-settle-egg-price-171229878.html
